name: backpack-forge-idle-merge-rpg
description: Backpack Forge: Idle Merge RPG — a one-handed backpack merge and idle auto-battler.

scripts.cap:sync: npm run build && cap sync android
scripts.android:debug: npm run cap:sync && cap run android --configuration debug
scripts.android:apk: npm run cap:sync && cd android && ./gradlew assembleRelease
scripts.android:aab: npm run cap:sync && cd android && ./gradlew bundleRelease
scripts.qa: npm run test && npm run build
